"""EVE Online industry planner CLI.

Usage:
  python industry.py recipe <Product or Blueprint name> --sde <SDE directory>
      [-me <0-10>] [-te <0-20, even>] [-waste]
  python industry.py invention <Product or Blueprint name> --sde <SDE directory> [--skill <1-5>]

This module only parses arguments and wires the other modules together.
"""

import argparse
import sys

import blueprints
import catalog
import invention
import invention_report
import report
import volumes


def _build_report(name, sde_dir, me=0, te=0, show_waste=False):
    items = catalog.Catalog(sde_dir)
    industry = blueprints.Industry(sde_dir, items)
    volume_of = volumes.VolumeResolver(sde_dir, items)

    candidates = items.ids_named(name)
    if not candidates:
        raise LookupError("No published item named %r" % name)
    recipe = next(
        (r for r in (industry.recipe_for(t) for t in candidates) if r is not None), None
    )
    if recipe is None:
        raise LookupError("%r cannot be manufactured or reacted" % name)

    product = recipe.product_id
    volume, packaged = volume_of.volume(product)
    if not blueprints.material_efficiency_applies(recipe.activity):
        me = 0
    materials = []
    for mid, qty in recipe.materials:
        needed = blueprints.material_amount(qty, me)
        waste = blueprints.material_amount(qty, 0) - needed
        name_text = items.name(mid) if items.is_valid(mid) else str(mid)
        materials.append((name_text, needed, industry.is_buildable(mid), waste))
    return report.render(
        report.ReportInput(
            item_name=items.name(product),
            type_id=product,
            category=items.category_name(product),
            group=items.group_name(product),
            market_path=tuple(items.market_path(product)),
            tech_level=items.tech_level(product),
            volume=volume,
            volume_is_packaged=packaged,
            activity=recipe.activity,
            output_quantity=recipe.output_quantity,
            seconds=blueprints.job_seconds(recipe.seconds, te),
            materials=tuple(materials),
            show_waste=show_waste,
        )
    )


def _build_invention_report(name, sde_dir, skill_level):
    items = catalog.Catalog(sde_dir)
    planner = invention.Invention(sde_dir, items)

    candidates = items.ids_named(name)
    if not candidates:
        raise LookupError("No published item named %r" % name)
    plan = next(
        (p for p in (planner.plan(t, skill_level) for t in candidates) if p is not None), None
    )
    if plan is None:
        raise LookupError("%r cannot be invented or reverse engineered" % name)

    product = plan.product_id
    tech_level = items.tech_level(product)
    if tech_level not in ("Tech II", "Tech III"):
        tech_level = "Tech III" if plan.from_relics else "Tech II"
    return invention_report.render(
        invention_report.InventionReportInput(
            item_name=items.name(product),
            type_id=product,
            category=items.category_name(product),
            group=items.group_name(product),
            market_path=tuple(items.market_path(product)),
            tech_level=tech_level,
            base_blueprint=plan.base_blueprint,
            datacores=plan.datacores,
            quantity_per_run=plan.quantity_per_run,
            skills=plan.skills,
            seconds=plan.seconds,
            with_source=plan.from_relics,
            rows=tuple(
                (o.invented_from, o.decryptor, o.probability, o.runs, o.me, o.te)
                for o in plan.outcomes
            ),
        )
    )


def _efficiency(low, high, step, label):
    def parse(text):
        try:
            value = int(text)
        except ValueError:
            raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError("%s must be an integer" % label)
        if not low <= value <= high or value % step:
            kind = "an even integer" if step == 2 else "an integer"
            raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(
                "%s must be %s in [%d,%d], got %r" % (label, kind, low, high, text)
            )
        return value
    return parse


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="EVE Online industry planner")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    recipe = commands.add_parser("recipe", help="show the recipe for a product or blueprint")
    recipe.add_argument("name", nargs="+", help="exact product or blueprint typeName")
    recipe.add_argument("--sde", required=True, help="SDE directory")
    recipe.add_argument("--material-efficiency", "-me", dest="me", default=0, metavar="ME",
                        type=_efficiency(0, 10, 1, "material efficiency"),
                        help="material efficiency, integer in [0,10] (default 0)")
    recipe.add_argument("--time-efficiency", "-te", dest="te", default=0, metavar="TE",
                        type=_efficiency(0, 20, 2, "time efficiency"),
                        help="time efficiency, even integer in [0,20] (default 0)")
    recipe.add_argument("--display-waste", "-waste", dest="waste", action="store_true",
                        help="show materials wasted because ME is below 10")
    invent = commands.add_parser("invention", help="plan invention for a Tech II/III product")
    invent.add_argument("name", nargs="+", help="exact product or blueprint typeName")
    invent.add_argument("--sde", required=True, help="SDE directory")
    invent.add_argument("--skill", type=int, default=5, choices=range(1, 6), metavar="{1-5}",
                        help="level of every relevant skill (default 5)")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    try:
        if args.command == "invention":
            text = _build_invention_report(" ".join(args.name), args.sde, args.skill)
        else:
            text = _build_report(" ".join(args.name), args.sde, args.me, args.te, args.waste)
    except (LookupError, OSError) as exc:
        print("error: %s" % exc, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print(text)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ReportInput:
    item_name: str
    type_id: int
    category: str
    group: str
    market_path: tuple  # market group names, root to leaf
    tech_level: str
    volume: float
    volume_is_packaged: bool
    activity: str
    output_quantity: int
    seconds: int
    materials: tuple  # of (name, quantity, buildable, waste)

def _volume_text(volume, packaged):
    if packaged:
        return "%.2f" % volume
    text = repr(float(volume))
    if "e" in text or "E" in text:
        text = format(volume, "f").rstrip("0")
        text = text + "0" if text.endswith(".") else text
    return text


def render(data):
    market = " > ".join(data.market_path) if data.market_path else "None"
    lines = [
        "ITEM: %s (%d)" % (data.item_name, data.type_id),
        "Group: %s > %s" % (data.category, data.group),
        "Market Group: %s" % market,
        "Tech Level: %s" % data.tech_level,
        "Volume: %s" % _volume_text(data.volume, data.volume_is_packaged),
        "",
        "Recipe:",
        "Activity: %s" % data.activity,
        "Output Quantity: %d" % data.output_quantity,
        "Run Time: %d" % math.ceil(data.seconds / 60),
    ]
    if data.show_waste:
        lines += ["| Item | Quantity | Waste | Buildable |", "|:-:|:---:|:---:|---:|"]
    else:
        lines += ["| Item | Quantity | Buildable |", "|:-:|:---:|---:|"]
    for name, quantity, buildable, waste in sorted(
        data.materials, key=lambda m: (m[0].lower(), m[0])
    ):
        cells = [name, "%d" % quantity]
        if data.show_waste:
            cells.append("%d" % waste)

        lines.append("| %s |" % " | ".join(cells))

"""Canonical invention report text.

Secret: the exact layout of the invention report -- labels, ordering,
number formatting, time and probability rounding, and how the
probabilities table is drawn.
"""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class InventionReportInput:
    item_name: str
    type_id: int
    category: str
    group: str
    market_path: tuple  # market group names, root to leaf
    tech_level: str
    base_blueprint: tuple  # (name, type_id), or None to omit the line
    datacores: tuple  # of names, display order
    quantity_per_run: int
    skills: tuple  # of names, display order
    seconds: int
    with_source: bool  # show the "Invented From" column
    rows: tuple  # of (invented_from, decryptor, percent, runs, me, te), display order


_SOURCE_COLUMN = ("Invented From", 30)
_COLUMNS = (
    ("Decryptor", 33),
    ("Probability", 13),
    ("Runs", 6),
    ("ME", 4),
    ("TE", 4),
)


def _percent_text(percent):
    return str(Decimal(repr(percent)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))


def _table_line(cells, widths):
    return "|" + "".join(" " + str(c).ljust(w - 1) + "|" for c, w in zip(cells, widths))


def render(data):
    market = " > ".join(data.market_path) if data.market_path else "None"
    lines = [
        "ITEM: %s (%d)" % (data.item_name, data.type_id),
        "Group: %s > %s" % (data.category, data.group),
        "Market Group: %s" % market,
        "Tech Level: %s" % data.tech_level,
        "",
        "Invention:",
    ]
    if data.base_blueprint is not None:
        lines.append("Base: %s (%d)" % data.base_blueprint)
    lines += [
        "Datacores: %s" % ", ".join(data.datacores),
        "Required Per Run: %d" % data.quantity_per_run,
        "Skills: %s" % ", ".join(data.skills),
        "Time: %d" % math.ceil(data.seconds / 60),
        "Probabilities:",
    ]

    columns = ((_SOURCE_COLUMN,) if data.with_source else ()) + _COLUMNS
    titles = [title for title, _ in columns]
    widths = [width for _, width in columns]
    lines.append(_table_line(titles, widths))
    lines.append("|" + "".join("-" * w + "|" for w in widths))
    for source, decryptor, percent, runs, me, te in data.rows:
        cells = [decryptor, _percent_text(percent), runs, me, te]
        if data.with_source:
            cells.insert(0, source)
        lines.append(_table_line(cells, widths))
    return "\n".join(lines)

"""Parsing of plan build strings.

Secret: the textual grammar of a build string -- the optional "x{jobs}"
suffix, the item/normal/invention/reverse-engineering forms, their
defaults, and how an ambiguous string is resolved against known names.

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass

_JOBS = re.compile(r"^(?P<rest>.*\S)\s+[xX](?P<jobs>\d+)$")
_NORMAL = re.compile(r"^(?P<name>.+?)\s+(?P<runs>\d+)\s+(?P<me>\d+)\s+(?P<te>\d+)$")
_RUNS = re.compile(r"^(?P<name>.+?)\s+(?P<runs>\d+)$")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BuildRequest:
    name: str
    runs: int
    jobs: int
    me: int = 0
    te: int = 0
    decryptor: str = None  # set (possibly "None") only for invention
    relic: str = None  # set only for reverse engineering

    @property
    def invented(self):
        return self.decryptor is not None


def _invention_pattern(decryptors):
    choices = "|".join(re.escape(d) for d in sorted(decryptors, key=len, reverse=True))
    return re.compile(
        r"^(?P<name>.+?)\s+(?P<runs>\d+)\s+(?P<dec>%s)(?:\s+(?P<relic>.+))?$" % choices,
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )


def parse(text, decryptors, is_item, is_relic):
    """Parse a build string into a BuildRequest.

    decryptors: decryptor names ("None" included); is_item / is_relic:
    predicates telling whether a name is a known product / relic.
    """
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    jobs = 1
    match = _JOBS.match(text)
    if match:
        text, jobs = match.group("rest"), int(match.group("jobs"))

    candidates = []
    match = _NORMAL.match(text)
    if match:
        candidates.append(BuildRequest(
            match.group("name"), int(match.group("runs")), jobs,
            me=int(match.group("me")), te=int(match.group("te")),
        ))
    match = _invention_pattern(decryptors).match(text)
    if match:
        canonical = {d.lower(): d for d in decryptors}
        candidates.append(BuildRequest(
            match.group("name"), int(match.group("runs")), jobs,
            decryptor=canonical[match.group("dec").lower()],
            relic=match.group("relic"),
        ))
    match = _RUNS.match(text)
    if match:
        candidates.append(BuildRequest(match.group("name"), int(match.group("runs")), jobs))
    candidates.append(BuildRequest(text, 1, jobs))

    for request in candidates:
        if is_item(request.name) and (request.relic is None or is_relic(request.relic)):
            return request
    raise LookupError("Cannot parse build string %r" % text)

The `plan` command is implemented. Both examples from the spec (`Barrage L 10 None x10` and `Barrage L 10 10 20 x10`) produce exactly the expected `materials.csv` and `jobs.csv`. I also ran it on the short form, reverse engineering (Proteus and a Tengu subsystem), a decryptor, a reaction and bad input; those outputs are consistent with the formulas but there's nothing to compare them to. There are no automated tests, and `requirements.txt` is unchanged because no new dependencies were needed.

**What I added:**
- **`build_string.py`** reads the build string in all four forms. `x{N}` defaults to 1, and runs default to 1 in the short form. When a string could be read more than one way, it picks the reading whose item name (and relic name) actually exists.
- **`planner.py`** works out the jobs and what to buy:
  - For invented items, ME/TE and the maximum runs come from the decryptor's result. Expected attempts are `ceil(copies needed / success chance)`.
  - Each attempt uses up the datacores, plus one decryptor (unless `None`) and one relic for reverse engineering.
  - Total build time is `time × runs × (1 − TE) × (1 − te_bonus)`, and ME is ignored for reactions.
  - The config is checked: `te_bonus` must be 0–30 and `invention_skill` 1–5.
- **`plan_report.py`** writes the two CSV files with the required headers and sort orders, and creates the output folder if it doesn't exist.
- **Existing code:**
  - Recipes now record which blueprint they come from, so jobs can be named after it.
  - Invention results now carry the materials each job uses.
  - `industry.py` has the new `plan` subcommand.

**One rule change to existing code:** in the ME 10 example R.A.M. must come to 100, not 90, which means every run uses at least 1 unit of each material. `blueprints.material_amount` now uses that minimum, which is the actual EVE rule. The `recipe` command is unaffected because it always works out a single run.

**Judgment calls where the spec is silent** (all give the same results on both examples):
- **Too many runs for one blueprint copy:** if you ask for more runs per job than an invented copy allows, each job is split into full-size jobs plus a leftover job. For example, 25 runs on an 11-run copy becomes 2×11 + 1×3 per job.
- **Sharing a copy:** one copy can serve `floor(max runs / runs per job)` jobs, since a single job can't draw on two copies.
- **Decryptors and relics** are listed under things to buy. The Tech I blueprint copy that invention starts from is not, which matches the example.
- **Nothing is built in-house yet:** only the top-level item is built. Materials that could themselves be made, such as Fernite Carbide, are bought, as the example shows.
- **Number formats:** `days` is rounded half-up to 2 decimals and written as a plain number (e.g. `1.28`, `0.8`). `buy_volume` is exact, not rounded, and also written as a plain number (e.g. `2940.0`).
- **Fixed columns:** `start_amount` and `end_amount` are always 0.
